mapper.sql: id, event_no, subscription_id, user_id, event_type, status, title, summary, detail_summary, object_type, object_id, severity, generated_time, delivered_time, error_code, create_time, create_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_proactive_event (event_no, subscription_id, user_id, event_type, status, title, summary, detail_summary, object_type, object_id, severity, generated_time, delivered_time, error_code, create_time, create_by) VALUES (#{eventNo}, #{subscriptionId}, #{userId}, #{eventType}, #{status}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{detailSummary}, #{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{severity}, #{generatedTime}, #{deliveredTime}, #{errorCode}, #{createTime}, #{createBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_ai_proactive_event WHERE subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} ORDER BY generated_time DESC, id DESC
